text.facebook: Vets estimate about one in seven clients now use AI in their animals' care, the British Veterinary Association said this week, and it warned AI can lead to confusion and even welfare harms. My tip: if your dog has eaten something it shouldn't on a walk, or is lame, bleeding or just not right, ring your vet first and ask the chatbot later. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/ai-and-your-dogs-health
